summary.text: Rob Gurtcheff II is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 170, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Martina White.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a family man, veteran and fraud investigator in Northeast Philadelphia.

paragraphs.text: Rob Gurtcheff II served in the U.S. Army from 1999 to 2004, according to Ballotpedia.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In his 2026 survey response, he said he would bring his investigative background to addressing fraud and abuse in government and listed affordability, healthcare and schools as his policy priorities.
